attributes.title: NTI 2027
attributes.series: AACN National Teaching Institute & Critical Care Exposition (NTI)
attributes.summary:
NTI 2027, the American Association of Critical-Care Nurses' annual teaching institute, runs May 2 to 5, 2027, in Indianapolis. Sessions are held at the Indiana Convention Center and the neighboring JW Marriott Indianapolis, and AACN expects an exhibit hall of more than 300 companies.

AACN says attendees can earn more than 40 continuing education contact hours; the per-session breakdown and pharmacology hours have not been published yet. Registration opens in early December 2026. Full-conference rates are $775 for members and $990 for nonmembers from December 1 to February 1, $915 and $1,130 from February 2 to April 5, and $985 and $1,200 from April 6 to May 5. AACN has already named Boston as a future NTI host city.
